venues.name: Tad Gormley Stadium
venues.ticketNote: Jesuit home games. Posts closer to game day.
venues.bagPolicy: CLEAR bags only, max 12x12x16 in. A small clutch of any material up to 4.5x6.5 in. is fine. All bags subject to search.
venues.prohibited: Coolers. Non-clear bags, backpacks, purses. Seat cushions with pockets. Metal-detector wanding at all gates.
venues.parking: City Park — lots along Marconi Dr and Roosevelt Mall. Arrive early; lots fill.

venues.name: John Ryan Stadium
venues.address: Jesuit High School campus, Metairie, LA
venues.bagPolicy: Follow the Jesuit clear-bag policy: clear bags, or a small clutch up to 4.5x6.5 in.

venues.name: Joe Yenni Stadium
venues.prohibited: Coolers, non-clear diaper bags, backpacks, drawstring bags, computer bags, camera bags.

venues.name: Chalmette High School
venues.address: 1100 E Judge Perez Dr, Chalmette, LA 70043
venues.bagPolicy: CLEAR bags only, max 12x6x12 in. A clear small purse is fine.
venues.prohibited: Book bags, large purses, fanny packs. Diaper bags allowed ONLY if you are entering with a child.
venues.driveNote: NO exit and re-entry — once you leave, you are out.

venues.name: Northshore High School
venues.bagPolicy: CLEAR totes max 12x8x12 in., or a clear small purse max 4.5x6.5 in. One bag per person.

venues.name: SLU — Strawberry Stadium
venues.bagPolicy: CLEAR bags max 12x6x12 in., OR one one-gallon clear freezer bag. A small clutch is fine.
venues.prohibited: Backpacks, purses, fanny packs, briefcases, camera cases, oversized totes, printed-pattern and mesh bags.
venues.driveNote: About a 1 hour drive from New Orleans.

venues.name: St. Thomas More — Cougar Stadium
venues.ticketNote: Via STM GoFan. Clear bags are sold at the Cougar Closet.
venues.bagPolicy: CLEAR bags only, max 12x6x12 in. A small clutch up to 4.5x6.5 in. is fine.
venues.prohibited: Non-clear bags, backpacks, purses larger than clutch size.
venues.driveNote: About a 2.5 hour drive from New Orleans. Capacity roughly 4,500.

venues.name: Morris F.X. Jeff Stadium
venues.address: Algiers, New Orleans, LA (formerly Behrman Stadium)
venues.bagPolicy: CLEAR bags only. A small clutch max 4.5x6.5 in. is fine.
venues.prohibited: Non-clear bags, purses over clutch size, coolers, backpacks.

traditions.title: Ask your son first
traditions.detail: Coaches communicate directly with the players, and that independence is an intentional part of the Jesuit experience. Schedule changes, equipment reminders, and what to bring are usually in your son's hands before they reach yours.

traditions.title: Donuts by 7:10 am
traditions.detail: The Freshman class delivers donuts and milk to the locker room by 7:10 am the morning before each game. One of the players' favorite traditions.

traditions.title: Chocolate milk, not Gatorade
traditions.detail: New this year at Coach Manale's request, post-game Gatorade has been replaced with chocolate milk. Two volunteers per grade bring an ice chest of 24, kept cold, to where players exit the field.

traditions.title: Senior parents wear white
traditions.detail: A long-standing tradition for the Senior Parent Photo. The photo goes into the Jesuit Football Program and cannot be photoshopped, so arrive on time.

traditions.title: Roses with a bow
traditions.detail: Presentation roses from Villere's florist, tied with a bow, for Senior Night.

traditions.title: Treat bags
traditions.detail: Every varsity player, trainer, and manager gets a treat bag the day before each game, with a note tucked in. Funded by $30 of every grade's dues.

traditions.title: Tailgate breakdown
traditions.detail: Parents of players who are not starters lend a hand with breakdown so senior parents and parents of starters can get into the stadium by game time.

keyDates.title: Media Guide ad deadline
